_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds.
name: communication
summary: Messages tied to the item they are about: from whom, to whom, about what, pending until resolved; what waits for a person, what was said about an item, what is overdue. On work, so a blocked item's block is what the first message carries.

changelog.note: reminder_of: a reminder is a message of its own about a pending message past its due date, sent once a day by `oto work remind`, never a reply (roadmap N5); CM4 lists the reminders a message had.

Replies (N4): in_reply_to and outcome; a message's status is derived from its replies (resolved, else replied); a message that is not a reply must name a recipient (policy, in place of the shape). `oto work inbox` (N3) and `oto work reply --resolve`, which also unblocks the item.
First release (roadmap N1, M6): Message from, to, about, body, sent, status, due; `oto work notify` writes one from a block to whom it waits on; CM1-CM3, awaiting confirmation.
